AssessmentItemBodyAssociateInteractionXM.description: An associate interaction presents candidates with a number of choices and allows them to create associations between them. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyChoiceInteractionXML.description: The choice interaction presents a set of choices to the candidate. The candidate's task is to select one or more of the choices, up to a maximum of maxChoices. The interaction is always initialized with no choices selected. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyCustomInteractionXML.description: The custom interaction provides an opportunity for extensibility of this specification to include support for interactions not currently documented.  The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyDrawingInteractionXML.description: The drawing interaction allows the candidate to use a common set of drawing tools to modify a given graphical image (the canvas). It must be bound to a response variable with base-type file and single cardinality. The result is a file in the same format as the original image. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyEndAttemptInteractionX.description: The end attempt interaction is a special type of interaction which allows item authors to provide the candidate with control over the way in which the candidate terminates an attempt. The candidate can use the interaction to terminate the attempt (triggering response processing) immediately, typically to request a hint. It must be bound to a response variable with base-type boolean and single cardinality. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyExtendedTextInteractio.description: An extended text interaction allows the candidate to enter an extended amount of text. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyGapMatchInteractionXML.description: A gap match interaction contains a number gaps that the candidate can fill from an associated set of choices. The candidate must be able to review the content with the gaps filled in context, as indicated by their choices. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyGraphicGapMatchInterac.description: A graphic gap-match interaction is a graphical interaction with a set of gaps that are defined as areas (hotspots) of the graphic image and an additional set of gap choices that are defined outside the image. The candidate must associate the gap choices with the gaps in the image and be able to review the image with the gaps filled in context, as indicated by their choices. Care should be taken when designing these interactions to ensure that the gaps in the image are a suitable size to receive the required gap choices. It must be clear to the candidate which hotspot each choice has been associated with. When associated, choices must appear wholly inside the gaps if at all possible and, where overlaps are required, should not hide each other completely. If the candidate indicates the association by positioning the choice over the gap (e.g., drag and drop) the system should 'snap' it to the nearest position that satisfies these requirements. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyGraphicOrderInteractio.description: A graphic order interaction is a graphic interaction with a corresponding set of choices that are defined as areas of the graphic image. The candidate's task is to impose an ordering on the areas (hotspots). The order hotspot interaction should only be used when the spatial relationship of the choices with respect to each other (as represented by the graphic image) is important to the needs of the item. Otherwise, orderInteraction should be used instead with separate material for each option. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyHotSpotInteractionXML.description: A hotspot interaction is a graphical interaction with a corresponding set of choices that are defined as areas of the graphic image. The candidate's task is to select one or more of the areas (hotspots). The hotspot interaction should only be used when the spatial relationship of the choices with respect to each other (as represented by the graphic image) is important to the needs of the item. Otherwise, choiceInteraction should be used instead with separate material for each option. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyHottextInteractionXML.description: The hottext interaction presents a set of choices to the candidate represented as selectable runs of text embedded within a surrounding context, such as a simple passage of text. Like choiceInteraction, the candidate's task is to select one or more of the choices, up to a maximum of maxChoices. The interaction is initialized from the defaultValue of the associated response variable, a NULL value indicating that no choices are selected (the usual case). The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyInlineChoiceInteractio.description: A inline choice is an inline interaction that presents the user with a set of choices, each of which is a simple piece of text. The candidate's task is to select one of the choices. Unlike the Choice Interaction, the delivery engine must allow the candidate to review their choice within the context of the surrounding text.

AssessmentItemBodyMatchInteractionXML.description: A match interaction presents candidates with two sets of choices and allows them to create associates between pairs of choices in the two sets, but not between pairs of choices in the same set. Further restrictions can still be placed on the allowable associations using the matchMax attribute of the choices. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyMediaInteractionXML.description: The media interaction allows more control over the way the candidate interacts with a time-based media object and allows the number of times the media object was experienced to be reported in the value of the associated response variable, which must be of base-type integer and single cardinality. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyOrderInteractionXML.description: In an order interaction the candidate's task is to reorder the choices, the order in which the choices are displayed initially is significant. By default the candidate's task is to order all of the choices but a subset of the choices can be requested using the maxChoices and minChoices attributes. When specified the candidate must select a subset of the choices and impose an ordering on them. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyPositionObjectInteract.description: The position object interaction consists of a single image which must be positioned on another graphic image (the stage) by the candidate. Like selectPointInteraction, the associated response may have an areaMapping that scores the response on the basis of comparing it against predefined areas but the delivery engine must not indicate these areas of the stage. Only the actual position(s) selected by the candidate shall be indicated. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodySelectPointInteraction.description: A graphic associate interaction is a graphic interaction with a corresponding set of choices that are defined as areas of the graphic image. The candidate's task is to associate the areas (hotspots) with each other. The graphic associate interaction should only be used when the graphical relationship of the choices with respect to each other (as represented by the graphic image) is important to the needs of the item. Otherwise, associateInteraction should be used instead with separate Material for each option. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

Like hotspotInteraction, a select point interaction is a graphic interaction. The candidate's task is to select one or more points. The associated response may have an areaMapping that scores the response on the basis of comparing it against predefined areas but the delivery engine must not indicate these areas of the image. Only the actual point(s) selected by the candidate shall be indicated. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodySliderInteractionXML.description: The slider interaction presents the candidate with a control for selecting a numerical value between a lower and upper bound. It must be bound to a response variable with single cardinality with a base-type of either integer or float. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyTextEntryInteractionXM.description: A textEntry interaction obtains a simple piece of text from the candidate. Like inlineChoiceInteraction, the delivery engine must allow the candidate to review their choice within the context of the surrounding text. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemBodyUploadInteractionXML.description: The upload interaction allows the candidate to upload a pre-prepared file representing their response. It must be bound to a response variable with base-type file and single cardinality. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemAPIPItemBodyXML.description: The item body contains the text, graphics, media objects, and interactions that describe the item's content and information about how it is structured. The body is presented by combining it with stylesheet information, either explicitly or implicitly using the default style rules of the delivery or authoring system. This element contains the appropriate XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification defining the various item body interactions.

AssessmentItemAPIPModalFeedbackXML.description: Modal feedback is shown to the candidate directly following response processing. The value of an outcome variable is used in conjunction with the showHide and identifier attributes to determine whether or not the feedback is shown in a similar way to feedbackElement. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemAPIPOutcomeDeclarationXML.description: Outcome variables are declared by outcome declarations. Their value is set either from a default given in the declaration itself or by a responseRule during response processing.  The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemAPIPResponseDeclarationXML.description: Response declarations state what the response variables include.  The response declaration may assign an optional correct response. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemAPIPResponseProcessingTemp.description: These templates are described using the processing language defined in IMS Global APIP specification and are distributed (in XML form) along with it. Delivery engines that support generalized response processing do not need to implement special mechanisms to support them as a template file can be parsed directly while processing the assessment item that refers to it. This element provides the URL for the template.

AssessmentItemAPIPResponseProcessingXML.description: Response processing is the process by which the Delivery Engine assigns outcomes based on the learner's responses. The outcomes may be used to provide feedback to the learner Feedback is either provided immediately following the end of the learner's attempt or it is provided at some later time, perhaps as part of a summary report on the item session. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemAPIPTemplateDeclarationXML.description: Template declarations declare item variables that are to be used specifically for the purposes of cloning items. They can have their value set only during template processing. They are referred to within the item body in order to individualize the clone and possibly also within the response Processing rules if the cloning process affects the way the item is scored.  The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemAPIPTemplateProcessingXML.description: Template processing consists of one or more template rules that are followed by the cloning engine or delivery system in order to assign values to the template variables. Template processing is identical in form to responseProcessing except that the purpose is to assign values to template variables, not outcome variables. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.

AssessmentItemPossibleResponseOption.description: The possible response presented to the participant within a selected-response/multiple-choice assessment item.

AssessmentItemPossibleResponseValue.description: The description of each distracter on an assessment item, explaining why it is there, what misunderstandings it exposes.

hasAssessmentItemPossibleResponseCorrect.description: Indicates that the possible response is the correct response.

AssessmentItemResponseAidSetUsed.description: A tool or aid set used while viewing the item. This can include things like a calculator, reference tools, etc.

AssessmentItemResponseFirstAttemptDurati.description: The amount of time in seconds or milliseconds that a person took to give an initial response, a first attempt to answer a formative assessment item.

AssessmentItemResponseHintCount.description: The total number of hints presented as the learner responded to a formative assessment item.  This may include hints requested by the learner or hints automatically presented such as in an online tutoring system. Presentation of a scaffolding item is a separate response record and not counted as a hint.

AssessmentItemResponseScoreValue.description: The score given to a person's response to an assessment item.

AssessmentItemResponseSecurityIssue.description: The description of security issue, if any, related to a learner's response to an assessment item.

AssessmentItemResponseStartDate.description: The date on which the assessment item was presented to the learner.

AssessmentItemResponseStartTime.description: The time of day that the assessment item was presented to the learner.

AssessmentItemResponseValue.description: A specific response to an assessment item by the person being assessed.

AssessmentItemResultXML.description: The  assessment item result formatted according to the IMS Global QTI  Specification.

hasAssessmentItemResponseHintIncludedAns.description: Indicates that one of the hints presented included the correct answer.

hasAssessmentItemResponseScaffoldingItem.description: Indicates that the response is to a scaffolding problem rather than the main/assigned problem. A scaffolding item is a follow-up formative assessment item used to assess prerequisite or component skills, presented immediately after a learner gives an incorrect answer on the previous item.

hasAssessmentItemResponseScoreStatus.description: The status of scoring a person's response to an assessment item.

hasAssessmentItemResponseStatus.description: The status of the response for a given item.

hasAssessmentItemRubricCriterionResult.description: References information about an assessment result or score derived using a rubic criterion.

hasLearnerAction.description: References information about clickstream data for online assessments and other experiences such as is used by intelligent tutoring systems. The model is compatible with the structure of data found in Experience API (xAPI) specification.

hasProficiencyStatus.description: An indication of whether a student's scores were proficient.

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryDIFValue.description: A value representing the Differential Item Functioning, also referred to as  measurement bias, for the assessment item.  The value represents differences in the functioning of the item across groups which are matched on the attribute being measure by the item.  The value is calculated using Mantel-Haenszel approach or a comparable algorithm so that a value of 1.0 represents no bias.

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryKappaValue.description: The measure used to represent the degree of agreement among raters.

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterA.description: The Item Response Theory value representing the discrimination of the item. The a parameter is found by taking the slope of the line tangent to the item characteristic curve at the inflection point, B. The parameter is the steepness of the curve at its steepest point.

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterB.description: The Item Response Theory value representing the difficulty of the item.   It is the Theta value for the location of the inflection point of the item characteristic curve.

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterC.description: The Item Response Theory value for multiple choice items representing the guessing of the item. The c parameter is a lower asymptote. It is the low point of the curve as it moves to negative infinity on the horizontal axis. You can think of c as the probability that a chicken would get the item right.

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD1.description: For   polytomous assessment items with more than two possible responses, this is the item response theory value representing the threshold between the first and second item characteristic functions.

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD2.description: For   polytomous assessment items with more than two possible responses, this is the item response theory value representing the threshold between the second and third item characteristic functions.

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD3.description: For   polytomous assessment items with more than three possible responses, this is the item response theory value representing the threshold between the third and fourth item characteristic functions.

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD4.description: For   polytomous assessment items with more than four possible responses, this is the item response theory value representing the threshold between the fourth and fifth item characteristic functions.

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD5.description: For   polytomous assessment items with more than five possible responses, this is the item response theory value representing the threshold between the fifth and sixth item characteristic functions.

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD6.description: For   polytomous assessment items with more than six possible responses, this is the item response theory value representing the threshold between the sixth and seventh item characteristic functions.

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryPointBiseria.description: The correlation between correct answers on this item and total correct answers on the test during a previous administration.

hasAssessmentItemResponseTheoryKappaAlgo.description: The algorithm used to derive the Assessment Item Kappa Value

hasAssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameter.description: A category for the difficulty of the item based on the Item Response Theory value.

hasAssessmentNeedAlternativeRepresentati.description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the default presentation mode of the associated Alternative Representations accessibility.

hasAssessmentNeedDirectionsOnly.description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile whether or not the verbal alternative content presentation should be applied to directive content only.

hasAssessmentNeedItemTranslationDisplayL.description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the default language for the displayed translation.

hasAssessmentNeedKeywordTranslationLangu.description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the default language for the keyword translation.

hasAssessmentNeedReadAtStartPreference.description: Used as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile to define if the spoken play-back should commence from the start of a recording or not.

hasAssessmentNeedSpokenSourcePreferenceT.description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the preferred spoken audio form.

AssessmentNeedBackgroundColor.description: This is the preferred Background color for screen enhancement defined as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile.

hasAssessmentNeedIncreasedWhitespacingTy.description: Defines the user preferences for white spacing in lines, words and characters as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile.

AssessmentNeedNumberOfBrailleCells.description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the number of active Braille cells in a Braille display.

hasAssessmentNeedBrailleGradeType.description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the grade of Braille to use when using a Braille display.

hasAssessmentNeedBrailleMarkType.description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile what textual properties to mark when using a Braille display.

hasAssessmentNeedBrailleStatusCellType.description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the preferred presence or location of a Braille display status cell.

hasAssessmentNeedNumberOfBrailleDotsType.description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the number of dots in a Braille cell.

hasAssessmentNeedUsageType.description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the rating for the collection of Access for All (AfA) needs and preferences.

hasAssessmentNeedInvertColorChoice.description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the Access for All (AfA) preference to invert the foreground and background Colors.

hasAssessmentNeedHazardType.description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile a characteristic of a digital resource that may be specified as being dangerous to a user.

hasAssessmentNeedKeywordTranslationLangu.description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the default language for the keyword translation.

hasAssessmentPersonalNeedLanguageLearner.description: References information that indicates a person's need related as a language learner that may be used to deternine the need for an assessment accomodation.

AssessmentRegistrationCompletionStatusDa.description: The date and time the completion and scoring status was changed for an instance of a person taking an assessment.

AssessmentRegistrationScorePublishDate.description: The date set by the testing program when the test scores are published.  For formative or classroom assessments, this will likely be the date when the scored the individual test.  For summative assessments, this date is likely set for a group of assessments when the processing system releases the scores.

AssessmentRegistrationTestAttemptIdentif.description: A unique identifier for the test attempt assigned by the delivery system.

hasAssessmentRegistrationParticipationIn.description: An indication of whether a student participated in an assessment.

hasAssessmentRegistrationReasonNotComple.description: The primary reason a participant did not complete an assessment.

hasAssessmentRegistrationRetestIndicator.description: Indicates if this registration is for a retest (retake). Retest can occur if a student failed a prior attempt and is eligible to retake. Other retest scenarios also can occur.

hasAssessmentResult.description: References an entity that includes information about a person's results from an assessment which may be for the entire assessment or one aspect of evaluation. The scoring method is defined by the related Assessment Subtest. The entity includes the score value and information about the score, such as a diagnostic statement.

hasGradeLevelWhenAssessed.description: The grade or developmental level of a student when assessed.

hasLEAFullAcademicYear.description: An indication of whether a student was in membership in the LEA education unit for a full academic year, according to the state's definition of Full Academic Year.

hasOrganization.description: References an organized group of one or more people with particular purpose.

hasReasonNotTested.description: The primary reason a student is not tested.

hasSchoolFullAcademicYear.description: An indication of whether a student was in membership in the school education unit for a full academic year, according to the state's definition of Full Academic Year.

hasStateFullAcademicYear.description: An indication of whether a student was in membership in the state education unit for a full academic year, according to the state's definition of Full Academic Year.

AssessmentResultDateCreated.description: The date on which the assessment result was generated.

AssessmentResultDateUpdated.description: The most recent date that the result was calculated/updated.  The value should be the same as Assessment Result Date Created if the subtest has only been scored once, but may be different if the score was recalculated with a different result.

AssessmentResultDescriptiveFeedback.description: The formative descriptive feedback that was given to a learner based on a scored/evaluated portion of an assessment as recorded in the result entity.

AssessmentResultDescriptiveFeedbackDateT.description: The date and time the descriptive feedback was entered for a scored/evaluated portion of an assessment.

AssessmentResultDescriptiveFeedbackSourc.description: Identifies the source of the descriptive feedback that was given to a learner based on a scored/evaluated portion of an assessment. May indicate if this is teacher, scorer, or system generated feedback. Values for this attribute would be determined by the assessment program.

AssessmentResultDiagnosticStatement.description: A statement intended for use by education professionals, using professional terminology, to interpret learner needs based on the scored/evaluated portion of an assessment.  This statement may inform Descriptive Feedback given to the learner.

AssessmentResultNumberOfResponses.description: The number of responses that are included with the Student Score Set. Responses are those items that were attempted (partially or fully answered) by the student and not necessarily the number of items in the assessment (which can be determined from the assessment object).

AssessmentResultScoreValue.description: A meaningful raw score, derived score, or statistical expression of the performance of a person on an assessment. The type of result is indicated by the Assessment Score Metric Type element. The results can be expressed as a number, percentile, range, level, etc. The score relates to all scored items or a sub test scoring one aspect of performance on the test. This value may or may not correspond to one or more Performance Levels.

AssessmentResultScoreValueStandardError.description: The measure of sampling variability and measurement error for the score, the amount of error to be expected in the score.

DiagnosticStatementSource.description: Identifies the source of the Diagnostic Statement based on a scored/evaluated portion of an assessment.

EarlyLearningOutcomeMeasurementDate.description: The date on which the assessment is conducted to determine the outcome.

InstructionalRecommendation.description: This provides the next steps for instruction for the student based upon the assessment results and student characteristics.

hasAssessmentPerformanceLevel.description: References information about the performance levels that may be assigned to an Assessment Subtest Result and specifications for selecting the performance level based on a score. hasAssessmentResultDataType.description: The data type of the assessment result score value.

hasAssessmentResultPreliminaryIndicator.description: If this score is preliminary, then this attribute value should be set. Preliminary scores may be provided for early use by the assessment program or user while final scoring is occurring.

hasAssessmentResultPretestOutcome.description: The results of a pre-test in academic subjects.

hasAssessmentResultRubricCriterionResult.description: References information that links an assessment result record to a result defined within a RubricCriterion.

hasAssessmentResultScoreType.description: Indicates the purpose for which this assessment score instance was recorded.

hasAssessmentScoreMetricType.description: The specific method used to report the performance and achievement of the assessment. This is the metric that is being used to derive the scores.

hasEarlyLearningOutcomeMeasurementLevel.description: Use for outcome measures in early learning.

hasEarlyLearningOutcomeTimePoint.description: The point in time for which the result is used for an outcome measure.

hasMetricType.description: The measurement scale or level of measurement for a variable.

AssessmentSessionScheduledEndDateTime.description: Date and time the assessment is scheduled to end.

AssessmentSessionSpecialEventDescription.description: Describes special events that occur before during or after the assessment session that may impact use of results according to rules related to the Assessment Registration Testing Indicator.

hasAssessmentSessionSpecialCircumstanceT.description: An unusual event occurred during the administration of the assessment. This could include fire alarm, student became ill, etc.

hasAssessmentSessionStaffRole.description: References roles served related to the administration of an assessment session.

hasAssessmentSessionType.description: The type of session that is scheduled.

hasOrganization.description: References an organized group of one or more people with particular purpose.

hasAssessmentSessionStaffRoleType.description: The type of role served related to the administration of an assessment session.

AssessmentSubtestAbbreviation.description: The shortened name identifying the assessment for use in reference and/or reports.

AssessmentSubtestDescription.description: The description of the subtest (e.g., vocabulary, measurement, or geometry).

AssessmentSubtestIdentifier.description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to an assessment subtest.

AssessmentSubtestMaximumValue.description: The maximum value for the measurement.

AssessmentSubtestMinimumValue.description: The minimum value possible for the measurement.

AssessmentSubtestPublishedDate.description: The date on which the Subtest was published.

AssessmentSubtestRules.description: A description of the rules to produce a student test/subtest score from for a grouping of student item scores.

AssessmentSubtestScaleOptimalValue.description: The optimal value for this measurement.

AssessmentSubtestTitle.description: The name or title of the subtest.

AssessmentFormSubtestItemWeightCorrect.description: A weighting factor for how the item score is used to compute a sub-test score when the item is correct or partially correct. A weight of 0 indicates the item does not affect the sub test score.

AssessmentFormSubtestItemWeightNotAttemp.description: A weighting factor for how the item score is used to compute a sub-test score when the item has not been attempted by the student. Item weight should be a negative value if the item subtracts from the score if not attempted.

CompetencyDefinitionTypicalAgeRangeMaxim.description: The typical maximum age at which a person learns the defined competency.

FacilitiesIdentifier.description: A locally assigned unique number or alphanumeric code used to capture precise information on locations specific to a school (e.g., building number, class number, hall number, school bus number, computer station number, or internet protocol (IP) address).

FacilityAcquisitionDate.description: The date the property/facility was acquired.

FacilityBuildingName.description: The full, legally accepted or popularly accepted name of a building.

FacilityExpectedLife.description: The time, in years, of the expected useful life of a facility for the purposes of depreciation.

SiteName.description: The full, legally accepted  name of the institution at the site level.

TemperatureControlledBuildingArea.description: The sum of the Building Area capable of being regulated and maintained within a specific temperature range for a designated purpose, employing heating, cooling, insulation, or climate control systems.

hasBuildingHistoricStatus.description: An indication of whether or not a building is eligible to be or has been declared a landmark or historic building.

hasBuildingPrimaryUseType.description: The primary use type of the building in which a school is located.

hasBuildingSpace.description: References information describing and defining the uses of space within a building.

hasBuildingSystemComponent.description: References information about a component of a system within a facility including the installation date, lifecycle cost, description, and useful life.

hasBuildingUseType.description: How a building is principally used, regardless of its original design.

hasCampusStatus.description: The generalized use or control of a campus, independent of program type.

hasCampusType.description: The primary purpose for which a campus is designed and/or used.

hasFacilityAudit.description: References information about the process that assesses the safety, quality, and utilization of a facility or building.

hasFacilityBuildingPermanency.description: An indication of whether the building is built for permanent use in the same location or is relocatable.

hasFacilityDesign.description: References information about the layout of a facility or asset space.

hasFacilityEnergy.description: References information about energy consumption of a facility.

hasFacilityFinance.description: References information about a facility's financial condition or status including replacement value, allowed indeptedness amount, insurance deductable, and public education mill rate if applicable.

hasFacilityHazard.description: References information about hazardous conditions or materials at or near a facility.

hasFacilityJointUse.description: References how a facility is used by parties aside from a primary tenant such as school district.

hasFacilityLease.description: References an agreement of lending a capital asset.

hasFacilityManagement.description: References the way in which a facility is managed.

hasFacilityMandate.description: References information about the mandates applicable to a facility.

hasFacilityMortgage.description: References information about a mortgage of a facility including interest, total asset value, and type of mortgage.

hasFacilityOwnershipIndicator.description: Indicates the public or private entity holds legal title to the building and/or site.

hasFacilitySite.description: References information about a site at which a facility exists.

hasFacilityUtilization.description: References information about the ratio in which a facility is being utilized by the school district.

hasLocation.description: References a location such as a physical address or mailing address.

FacilityAuditDate.description: The month, day, and year of the systematic review or audit of facility quality, management, decision making processes, controls, schedule and cost.

hasFacilityAuditType.description: The type of systematic review or audit of facility quality, management, decision making processes, controls, schedule and cost.

ComponentOrFixtureCheckDate.description: The month, day, and year that the condition of a system, component, equipment, or fixture was  checked.

FacilityComplianceDeterminationDate.description: The month, day, and year that the school, building, site, system, component, equipment, or fixture compliance status was determined.

FacilityComplianceName.description: The name of the inspection or process that indicates conformity to the requirements or standards specified in federal, state, or local standards or codes.

FacilityComponentDeficiencyDescription.description: A description of the component, system, or finish that needs replacement, repair, or maintenance to perform at an optimal level.

FacilityEstimatedCostToEliminateDeferred.description: The estimated cost to bring systems, components, finishes, fixtures, or equipment to a state of good repair.

FacilityInspectionScoreResultDescription.description: The description of a meaningful raw score of statistical expression of the performance on an inspection.

FacilityInspectionViolationDescription.description: A description of the standard violation(s) found in the inspection.

hasFacilityComplianceStatus.description: An indication of whether the school, building, site, system, component, equipment, vehicle, or fixture conforms to the requirements or standards specified in federal, state, or local standards or codes or other officially required guidelines or regulations.

hasFacilityMaintenanceStandardType.description: The standard for maintenance of a component, system, or building.

BuildingArchitectName.description: The name of the architect of record for the building.

BuildingArchitecturalFirmName.description: The name of the architectural firm responsible for the building design.

BuildingDateOfCertificateOfOccupancy.description: The month, day and year in which a certificate of occupancy was granted by the appropriate local authority.

hasBuildingDesignType.description: The primary design or purpose of a building, as determined by its physical layout and built-in systems and equipment, regardless of its current use.

hasBuildingEnvironmentalOrEnergyPerforma.description: The primary groupings that rating organizations use to evaluate environmental sustainability and energy use.

hasFacilityDesignConstruction.description: References information about the construction of a facility or asset space.

hasFacilitySchoolDesign.description: References information about the type of school design applicable to a facility.

BuildingAdditionCode.description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to a building addition by a school, school system, state, or other agency or entity.

BuildingAdditionDescription.description: A description of the permanent structure added to the original building.

BuildingSiteImprovementDescription.description: A description of the designed and constructed improvements made to a site.

FacilityAdditionYear.description: The year the construction on the addition was completed.

FacilityConstructionDate.description: The month, day, and year on which construction of a building, addition, or improvement was completed.

FacilityConstructionYear.description: The year the building was first constructed.

hasBuildingEnergyConservationMeasureType.description: The type of modification to, or replacement of, a piece of equipment or building shell/system that increases energy efficiency.

hasFacilityConstructionDateType.description: Designation of the nature of the construction completion date.

hasFacilityConstructionMaterialType.description: The primary material used for the construction of a building.

hasFacilityJointDevelopmentType.description: The type of development where two or more entities partner to plan, site, design, and/or build a new school or renovate an existing school to better support the joint use of the building and/or land.

hasFacilitySiteImprovementLocationType.description: The type of location of the designed and constructed improvements made to a site.

hasFacilityStandardType.description: An indication of the district or state requirements or guidelines for the design and construction of school facilities.

BuildingEnergyServiceCompanyName.description: The name of the company that designs, procures, finances, installs, maintains, and guarantees the performance of energy conservation measures in an owner's facility or facilities.

hasBuildingEnergySourceType.description: The source of energy that directly powers a school district facility or building system.

hasFacilityUtilityProviderType.description: An indication of how utilities are supplied to a site or a building by a company or provider.

hasFacilityUtilityType.description: The type of utility used in the operation of a facility.

FacilityReplacementValue.description: The estimated cost of replacing a facility using current per square foot estimates of total project costs.

IndebtednessAmountAllowed.description: The amount of indebtedness allowed by law to be carried by the school district.

InsuranceDeductible.description: The dollar amount a school district must pay before its insurance will compensate it for loss.

PublicEducationMillRate.description: The millage rate used to calculate property tax revenue for K-12 public education.

hasFacilityLease.description: References an agreement of lending a capital asset.

hasFacilityMortgage.description: References information about a mortgage of a facility including interest, total asset value, and type of mortgage.

hasFacilityMortgageFee.description: References information about fees applicable to a facility mortgage.

hasOrganizationFinancial.description: References the intersection of FinancialAccount and OrganizationCalendarSession (representing an AccountingPeriod) and containing the values for that accounting period.

FacilityHazardousConditionExpectedRemedi.description: The month, day, and year by which a hazardous condition of a site or building is expected to be remediated.

FacilityLocationOfHazardousMaterials.description: The location at which the identified hazardous material is found.

FacilityNearbyEnvironmentalHazardDescrip.description: Description of any type of environmental hazards within range of the facility that has the potential to seriously affect the health, safety and operation of school facilities and their occupants.

HazardousMaterialOrConditionDescription.description: A description of the seriousness a threat or hazardous material poses.

HazardousMaterialOrConditionTestingDate.description: The month, day, and year that the site or building is tested for a specific hazardous material.

hasFacilityHazardousMaterialsOrCondition.description: The type of hazardous materials or conditions tested for at a site or building.

hasFacilityNaturallyOccurringHazardType.description: Type of natural hazard that can affect the health, safety and operation of school facilities and their occupants.

FacilityJointUseDescription.description: A description explaining the details of an organization's shared facility arrangement.

hasBuildingJointUseRationaleType.description: The reasons for permitting and participating in joint-use.

hasBuildingJointUseSchedulingType.description: The type of designation of non school district users by the amount of time they have access to public school for joint use.

hasBuildingJointUserType.description: The types of users sharing school district controlled, owned, or utilized facilities.

hasFacilityJointUseIndicator.description: An indication that an organization shares a facility or space within a facility with another organization.

FacilityLeaseAmount.description: The amount of money the school must pay to rent the facility that it is in.

hasFacilityLeaseAmountCategory.description: The category of payment that a school must pay to rent the facility that it is in.

hasFacilityLeaseType.description: The type of agreement that allows the use and possession of a school, building, or other facility from a third party in return for a regularly scheduled installment payment over an agreed-upon period.

hasBuildingCharterSchoolRealtyAccessType.description: The type of real estate vehicle through which a public charter school has access and control of its building space.

hasBuildingCleaningStandardType.description: The standard for cleanliness, and benchmarks for how much space can be assigned to one properly supplied custodian to meet these standards.

hasFacilityCapitalProgramManagementType.description: The type of management organization for planning, design, and construction of major capital projects.

hasFacilityComplianceAgencyType.description: The type of agency that has ultimate responsibility for the compliance determination.

hasFacilityManagementPlan.description: References information describing a financial management plan and metadata about the applicable types of plans.

hasFacilityOperationsManagementType.description: The type of management arrangements whereby a district oversees and manages its facilities operations.

FacilitiesPlanDescription.description: A description of the management and accountability plan.

hasFacilitiesManagementEmergencyType.description: The type of abnormal and urgent circumstances that disrupt the normal operation of the building, threaten the health and safety of the occupants, or require an emergency response.

hasFacilitiesPlanType.description: The type of management and accountability plan.

FacilityStateOrLocalMandateName.description: The specific law, rule, regulation, or standard of a state or local government that pertains to public school facilities.

hasFacilitiesMandateAuthorityType.description: The authority that mandates through law, regulation, or standard that pertains to a specific mandate.

hasFacilityApplicableFederalMandateType.description: The particular federal law, regulation, or standard that pertains to a school facility.

hasFacilityCompliance.description: References designation that assesses whether a facility or building meets safety and teaching standards set by the school district, state, and federal agencies.

hasFacilityFederalMandateInterestType.description: The area of interest controlled by a federal law, regulation, or standard that pertains to a school facility.

hasFacilityStateOrLocalMandateInterestTy.description: The area of interest controlled by a law, rule, regulation, or standard of state and local governments that pertains to public school facilities.

FacilityMortgageInterestAmount.description: The amount the borrower pays the lender to compensate the lender for the use of money to purchase a building or facility.

FacilityTotalAssessedValue.description: The total assessed value of property that constitutes the basis for public borrowing.

hasFacilityMortgageFee.description: References information about fees applicable to a facility mortgage.

hasFacilityMortgageInterestType.description: The type of interest paid on a mortgage to the lender to compensate the lender for the use of money to purchase a building or facility.

hasFacilityMortgageType.description: The status of a mortgage as it relates to priority of payment.

hasFacilityFinancingFeeType.description: The type of fee that one must pay when getting a mortgage.

hasBuildingSchoolDesignType.description: The physical layout and character of a school facility, as determined by age groups served and educational programs provided.

FacilitySiteArea.description: The total number of acres in a continuous piece of land, to the nearest tenth, including undeveloped areas as well as areas occupied by buildings, walks, drives, parking facilities, and other improvements.

FacilitySiteIdentifier.description: The lot and square number, or equivalent unique municipal number identification, of a parcel of land.

hasBuildingSiteUseRestrictionsType.description: A characterization of a site that would define restrictions or opportunities.

hasFacilitySiteOutdoorAreaType.description: The designated constructed outdoor area on a public school site.

BuildingHoursOfPublicUsePerWeek.description: The number of hours that all or part of a building is used for purposes other than general education by the community or other organizations.

BuildingNetAreaOfInstructionalSpace.description: The area of space directly used for instruction excluding circulation, administration, student services, and building support.

BuildingNumberOfTeachingStations.description: The number of teaching stations, as defined by how many spaces have, or could have, a teacher assigned to them for classroom instruction.

BuildingPublicUsePolicyDescription.description: A description of the policy that enables the community or other organizations to use all or part of a building for purposes other than general education.

EnrollmentCapacity.description: Maximum number of age-appropriate students who can be enrolled.

FacilityEnrollmentCapacity.description: The maximum number of age appropriate students who can be enrolled in a facility such that the district's programmatic, operational, and student/teacher work load requirements are met.

FinancialAccountDescription.description: The description for the financial account in an organization's accounting system.

FinancialAccountName.description: The name given to the financial account in an organization's accounting system.

FinancialAccountNumber.description: A number given to a financial account within a local source accounting system. The number may be a concatenation of a standard  prefix for the type of account with digits added that have specific meaning within the local system.

FinancialExpenditureProjectReportingCode.description: The project/reporting code permits organizations to accumulate expenditures to meet a variety of specialized reporting requirements at the local, state, and federal levels. It is a three-digit code with the format 00X. The first two digits identify the particular funding source, authority, or expenditure purpose for which a special record or report is required. The third digit is available to identify particular projects and the fiscal year of the appropriation within that funding source. Each classification is presented by a code range followed by a description.

hasFederalProgramCode.description: The unique five-digit number assigned to each federal program as listed in the Assistance Listings. See https://sam.gov/content/assistance-listings

hasFederalProgramSubgrantCode.description: An additional code appended to the Federal Program Code used to identify a subgrant of the grant identified by the Federal Program Code.

hasFinancialAccountBalanceSheetCode.description: Balance sheet accounts and statement of net position accounts are used to track financial transactions for each fund. Such financial statements only report assets, deferred outflows of resources, liabilities, deferred inflows of resources, and equity accounts and are considered "snapshots" of how these accounts stand as of a certain point in time.

hasFinancialAccountCategory.description: A label for a grouping of financial accounts, based on type and purpose.

hasFinancialAccountCodingSystemOrganizat.description: The type of organization that created the coding system for the financial account information.

hasFinancialAccountFundClassification.description: A fund is a separate fiscal and accounting entity with a self-balancing set of accounts recording cash and other financial resources, together with all related liabilities and residual equities or balances or changes therein.

hasFinancialAccountGASBRevenueClassifica.description: The classification of Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) revenues.

hasFinancialAccountLocalBalanceSheetCode.description: A local code used to describe balance sheet accounts and statement of net position accounts which are used to track financial transactions for each fund. Such financial statements only report assets, deferred outflows of resources, liabilities, deferred inflows of resources, and equity accounts and are considered "snapshots" of how these accounts stand as of a certain point in time.

hasFinancialAccountLocalFundClassificati.description: A local code used to classify a fund which is a separate fiscal and accounting entity with a self-balancing set of accounts recording cash and other financial resources, together with all related liabilities and residual equities or balances or changes therein.

hasFinancialAccountLocalGASBRevenueClass.description: A local code used to classify Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) revenues.

hasFinancialAccountLocalProgramCode.description: A local code used to describe a plan of activities and procedures designed to accomplish a predetermined objective or set of objectives.

hasFinancialAccountLocalRevenueCode.description: A local code used to record revenue and other receivables by source.

hasFinancialAccountProgramCode.description: A program is a plan of activities and procedures designed to accomplish a predetermined objective or set of objectives. The program classification provides the organization with a framework to classify instructional and other expenditures by program to determine cost.

hasFinancialAccountRevenueCode.description: These codes are for recording revenue and other receivables by source. Major revenue categories have codes ending in 00 and are further subdivided.

hasFinancialExpenditureFunctionCode.description: The function describes the activity for which a service or material object is acquired. The functions of an organization are classified into five broad areas: instruction, support services, operation of non-instructional services, facilities acquisition and construction, and debt service. Functions are further classified into sub functions.

hasFinancialExpenditureLevelofInstructio.description: This classification permits expenditures to be segregated by instructional level.

hasFinancialExpenditureLocalFunctionCode.description: A local code used to describe the activity for which a service or material object is acquired.

hasFinancialExpenditureLocalLevelOfInstr.description: A local code used to classify the segregation of expenditures by instructional level.

hasFinancialExpenditureLocalObjectCode.description: A local code used to describe the service or commodity obtained as the result of a specific expenditure.

hasFinancialExpenditureObjectCode.description: This classification is used to describe the service or commodity obtained as the result of a specific expenditure. Nine major object categories have codes ending in 00 and are further subdivided.

FinancialAccountProgramName.description: The name given to the program area in an organization's accounting system.

FinancialAccountProgramNumber.description: A number given to a program area within an organization's accounting system.

FinancialAidYearDesignator.description: The school year for which the student's financial aid application and award data apply.  Generally, this is the 12-month period from July 1 to June 30.

hasFinancialAidApplicationType.description: The type of financial application completed by an individual.

FinancialAidAwardAmount.description: The amount of financial aid awarded to a person for the term/year.

FinancialAidYearDesignator.description: The school year for which the student's financial aid application and award data apply.  Generally, this is the 12-month period from July 1 to June 30.

hasFinancialAidAwardStatus.description: An indication of whether the financial aid type being reported is aid that has been awarded, accepted or dispersed.

hasFinancialAidAwardType.description: The classification of financial aid awarded to a person for the academic term/year.

GoalDescription.description: A statement that describes the desired outcomes.

GoalEndDate.description: The date on which the goal expires or has been achieved.

GoalStartDate.description: The date on which the goal becomes active.

hasCompetencySet.description: References competencySet supports defining criteria for award or recognition of a credential or micro-credential based on a person's attainment of one or more CompetencyFrameworkItem(s). The set may have a completion criteria specifying if all or some of the items are required. If only some are required then Completion Criteria Threshold is used to specify how many. Competency Set may also include other Competency Sets so it is possible to make a rule such as "the person must complete these three required competency items and 2 out of 3 of these items specified in this sub set."

hasGoalMeasurement.description: References information that defines how a goal is to be measured. This may be included in a performance plan, learning plan or IEP.

hasGoalPerformance.description: References status at a point in time toward reaching a specific planned goal. These detailed records may be included in a progress report, such as a progress report for an IEP.

GoalMeasurementDescription.description: The procedures and/or instruments that will be used to measure achievement of a goal or short-term objective.

GoalMeasurementSchedule.description: Frequency of evaluation of progress toward meeting the goal or short-term objective.

GoalSuccessCriteria.description: One or more statements that describes the criteria used by teachers and students to check for attainment of a goal.

hasGoalMeasurementCriterion.description: References information about a threshold or rule used with a measurement to determine if a goal has been reached. This may be included in a performance plan, learning plan or IEP.

hasGoalMeasurementType.description: Type of evidence appropriate for assessing achievement of a goal or short-term objective.

GoalMeasurementCriterionAccuracyPercent.description: The percent of correct results that will be considered to represent successful achievement of a goal.

GoalMeasurementCriterionAttemptsCount.description: The number of attempts representing a completed trial for assessing achievement of a goal.

GoalMeasurementCriterionMetric.description: A metric used for evaluating achievement of a goal.

GoalMeasurementCriterionSuccessCount.description: The number of correct results that will be considered to represent successful achievement of a goal.

GoalCurrentPerformanceDescription.description: Current performance explanation related to the annual goal or short-term objectives.

GoalStatus.description: Description of status toward achievement of the annual goal or short-term objectives.

hasGoalStatusType.description: Status toward achievement of the annual goal or short-term objectives.

hasAuthorizationDocument.description: References information about a document that authorizes a deision or plan such as a document authorizing an IEP.

hasIEPAuthorizationDocumentType.description: Type of Individualized Education Plan document authorized.

hasIEPAuthorizationRejected.description: References information about a case in which a student was authorized for an IEP but the IEP was rejected by a parent or legal guardian.

IEPAuthorizationRejectedPortionDescripti.description: Portion the authorizer does not want executed.

IEPPresentLevelAcademicDescription.description: How the child's disability affects the child's academic achievement.

IEPPresentLevelFunctionalDescription.description: How the child's disability affects the child's functional performance.

IEPPresentLevelGeneralEducationDescripti.description: How the child's disability affects the child's involvement and progress in the general education curriculum.

IEPPresentLevelParentConcernDescription.description: Parent's explanation of their interest in or concerns about the student's participation in special education.

IEPPresentLevelPreschoolDescription.description: For preschool children, as appropriate, how the disability affects the child's participation in appropriate activities.

IEPPresentLevelStudentConcernDescription.description: Student's explanation of his or her interest in or concerns about participation in special education.

IEPPresentLevelStudentStrengthsDescripti.description: Explanation of perceived strengths and abilities of the student.

hasIPEDSFinanceFASBFinancialPositionCate.description: IPEDS financial position classification used by degree-granting private, not-for-profit institutions and public institutions using FASB Reporting Standards for reporting the assets, liabilities, and net assets in a manner consistent with the Statement of Financial Position in the General Purpose Financial Statements (GPFS).

hasIPEDSFinanceFASBFunctionalExpenseCate.description: A functional expense classification is a method of grouping expenses according to the purpose for which the costs are incurred. The classifications tell why an expense was incurred rather than what was purchased.

hasIPEDSFinanceFASBPellGrantTransactions.description: Method of reporting Pell Grants in IPEDS by degree-granting private, not-for-profit institutions and public institutions using FASB Reporting Standards.

hasIPEDSFinanceFASBRevenueCategory.description: IPEDS revenue classification used by degree-granting private, not-for-profit institutions and public institutions using FASB Reporting Standards for reporting revenues and investment return by source in a manner consistent with the definitions from the National Association of College and University Business Officers (NACUBO) Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual for Higher Education (FARM).

hasIPEDSFinanceFASBRevenueRestrictionCat.description: IPEDS revenue restriction classification used by degree-granting private, not-for-profit institutions and public institutions using FASB Reporting Standards for reporting revenues by restriction.

hasIPEDSFinanceFASBScholarshipsandFellow.description: IPEDS revenue category used by degree-granting private, not-for-profit institutions and public institutions using FASB Reporting Standards for the reporting of resources received for supporting student grant aid.

hasIPEDSFinanceGASBFinancialPositionCate.description: IPEDS financial position classification used by degree-granting public institutions using GASB Reporting Standards for reporting the assets, liabilities, and net position in a manner consistent with the Statement of Net Position in the General Purpose Financial Statements (GPFS).

hasIPEDSFinanceGASBFunctionalExpenseCate.description: A functional expense classification is a method of grouping expenses according to the purpose for which the costs are incurred. The classifications tell why an expense was incurred rather than what was purchased.

hasIPEDSFinanceGASBRevenueCategory.description: IPEDS revenue classification used by degree-granting public institutions using GASB Reporting Standards for reporting revenues and other additions by source including all operating revenues, nonoperating revenues, and other additions for the reporting period. This includes unrestricted and restricted revenues and additions, whether expendable or nonexpendable.

hasIPEDSFinanceGASBScholarshipsandFellow.description: IPEDS revenue category used by degree-granting public institutions using GASB Reporting Standards for the reporting of resources received for supporting student scholarships and fellowships.

hasIPEDSFinanceIntercollegiateAthleticsE.description: Identifies the functional expense category where the institution allocates its intercollegiate athletics expenses.

hasIPEDSFinanceNaturalExpenseCategory.description: A natural expense classification is a method of grouping expenses according to the type of costs that are incurred. The classifications tell what was purchased rather than why an expense was incurred.

IncidentCost.description: The value of any quantifiable monetary loss directly resulting from the incident. Examples include the value of repairs necessitated by vandalism of a school facility, the value of personnel resources used for repairs or consumed by the incident, the value of stolen items, and the value of time consumed by an incident (e.g., instructional time involved in evacuating a school during a false fire alarm).  Cost may be reported by specific monetary amount or range.

IncidentDate.description: The year, month and day on which the incident occurred.

IncidentIdentifier.description: A locally assigned unique identifier (within the school or school district) to identify each specific incident or occurrence. The same identifier should be used to document the entire incident even if it included multiple offenses and multiple offenders.

IncidentRegulationViolatedDescription.description: A description of the rule, regulation, or standard that was violated when an incident occurred (e.g., the identification of a relevant law, conduct standard, or acceptable use policy).

IncidentTime.description: An indication of the time of day the incident took place.

ReporterIdentifier.description: Identifies the reporter of the incident using  a pre-existing unique student identifier or unique staff identifier, when the reporter is a student or staff member.

hasHarassmentOrBullyingReligionType.description: The actual or perceived religious affiliation of a student that is the basis of an allegation of harassment or bullying.

hasIncidentActivity.description: The activity taking place during the occurrence.

hasIncidentBehavior.description: Categories of behavior coded for use in describing an incident.

hasIncidentInjuryType.description: An indication of the occurrence of physical injury to participants involved in the incident and, if so, the level of injury sustained.

hasIncidentLocation.description: Identifies where the incident occurred and whether or not it occurred on campus.

hasIncidentMultipleOffenseType.description: An indication of whether the offense was primary or secondary in nature when a single incident included more than one type of offense.

hasIncidentPerpetratorInjuryType.description: An indication of the occurrence of physical injury to the perpetrator(s) (participants) involved in the incident and, if so, the level of injury sustained.

hasIncidentPerson.description: References the relationship between a person and an Incident involving a student or school.

hasIncidentRelatedToDisabilityManifestat.description: An indication whether a student's behavior (offense) was a manifestation of, or related to, a disability condition.

hasIncidentReportedToLawEnforcementIndic.description: An indication that the school resource officer or any other law enforcement official was notified about the incident, regardless of whether official action is taken.

hasIncidentReporterType.description: Information on the type of person who reported the incident. When known and/or if useful, use a more specific option code (e.g., "Counselor" rather than "Professional Staff").

hasIncidentResponsibilityStaffIndicator.description: An indication of whether a staff member was determined to be involved in an incident as an offender (the person who committed the infraction constituting the incident).

hasIncidentTimeDescriptionCode.description: A code for the description of the time of day that an incident took place.

hasSecondaryIncidentBehavior.description: Supplemental information about an incident when the primary offense is more serious in nature than alcohol or drug, etc. offenses.

hasShootingIncidentIndicator.description: An indication of whether the incident involved a shooting, regardless of whether anyone was hurt or whether a student or non-student used a firearm or explosive device.

hasWeaponType.description: Identifies the type of weapon used during an incident.

IncidentPerpetratorIdentifier.description: Identifies the perpetrator of the incident by use of a pre-existing unique identifier assigned to a student or staff member by a school or district.

IncidentVictimIdentifier.description: Identifies the victim of the incident by use of a pre-existing unique identifier assigned to a student or staff member by a school or district.

IncidentWitnessIdentifier.description: Identifies the witness of the incident by use of a pre-existing unique identifier assigned to a student or staff member by a school or district. Using this data element permits linkage to descriptive information about the individual in the student or staff database.

hasIncidentPerpetratorType.description: Information on the type of individual who committed an incident. A "perpetrator" is an individual involved in an incident as an offender (the person who committed the infraction constituting the incident).

hasIncidentPersonRoleType.description: The role or type of participation of a person in a discipline incident.

hasIncidentVictimType.description: Information on the type of individual who was injured or otherwise harmed as a direct result of the incident. A "victim" is the individual who suffers injury or harm that directly results from the incident.

hasIncidentWitnessType.description: Information on the type of individual who witnessed the incident and can give a firsthand account of an incident that was seen, heard, or experienced.

FunctionalBehavioralAssessmentDate.description: The year, month and day on which the functional behavioral assessment was conducted.

IEPTransferofRightsStatement.description: Beginning not later than one year before the child reaches the age of majority under State law, the IEP must include a statement that the child has been informed of the child's rights under Part B of the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act, if any, that will transfer to the child on reaching the age of majority under �300.520.

IndividualizedProgramDate.description: The year, month and day on which the status of an individualized program for a student is significantly altered.

IndividualizedProgramInclusionMinutesPer.description: The number of minutes per week that a student with disabilities is served in a regular classroom with his or her non-disabled peers.

IndividualizedProgramNonInclusionMinutes.description: The number of minutes per week that a student with disabilities is served in a special education setting separate from his or her non-disabled peers.

IndividualizedProgramServicePlanDate.description: The year, month and day on which the status of the service plan for a child is established or significantly altered.

IndividualizedProgramServicePlanEndDate.description: The year, month and day on which the status of the service plan for a child effectively ends.

IndividualizedProgramServicePlanMeetingP.description: The position titles of individuals who attend the service plan meeting.

IndividualizedProgramServicePlanReevalua.description: Date student will be reevaluated for continued placement in a support program(s).

IndividualizedProgramServicePlanSignatur.description: The year, month and day on which the service plan document is signed.

IndividualizedProgramServicePlanSignedBy.description: The position titles of individuals who sign a written service plan.

The metro and nonmetro categories have been subdivided into three metro and six nonmetro groupings, resulting in a nine-part county codification. The codes allow researchers working with county data to break such data into finer residential groups beyond a simple metro-nonmetro dichotomy, particularly for the analysis of trends in nonmetro areas that may be related to degree of rurality and metro proximity.

hasDislocatedWorkerStatus.description: An individual who has been terminated or laid off, or who has received a notice of termination or layoff from employment, or an individual who was self-employed but is unemployed as a result of general economic conditions in the community in which the individual resides or because of natural disasters.
