hasEnglishLearnerStatus.description: In coordination with the state's definition based on Section 8101(20) of the ESEA, as amended by the ESSA, the term 'English learner', when used with respect to an individual, means an individual: (A) who is aged 3 through 21; (B) who is enrolled or preparing to enroll in an elementary school or a secondary school; (C) (i) who was not born in the United States or whose native languages are languages other than English; (ii) (I) who is a Native American or Alaska Native, or a native resident of the outlying areas; and (II) who comes from an environment where a language other than English has had a significant impact on the individual's level of English language proficiency; or (iii) who is migratory, whose native language is a language other than English, and who come from an environment where a language other than English is dominant; and (D) whose difficulties in speaking, reading, writing, or understanding the English language may be sufficient to deny the individual (i) the ability to meet the challenging State academic standards; (ii) the ability to successfully achieve in classrooms where the language of instruction is English; or (iii) the opportunity to participate fully in society.

hasHomelessUnaccompaniedYouthStatus.description: A homeless unaccompanied youth is a youth who is not in the physical custody of a parent or guardian and who fits the McKinney-Vento definition of homeless. Students must be both unaccompanied and homeless to be included as unaccompanied homeless youth. There is no age range specified for an unaccompanied youth in the law. The upper age range is determined by what a state defines as school age, unless the child is in special education. The upper age range for students in special education may extend to 22 years of age. There is no lower age range. Therefore, as an example, a young child not in the physical custody of a parent or guardian, though living with a caregiver, and is living in a situation that is not fixed, regular, and adequate, would be identified as a homeless unaccompanied youth.

hasIDEAIndicator.description: A person having intellectual disability; hearing impairment, including deafness; speech or language impairment; visual impairment, including blindness; serious emotional disturbance (hereafter referred to as emotional disturbance); orthopedic impairment; autism; traumatic brain injury; developmental delay; other health impairment; specific learning disability; deaf-blindness; or multiple disabilities and who, by reason thereof, receive special education and related services under the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA) according to an Individualized Education Program (IEP), Individual Family Service Plan (IFSP), or service plan.

hasLowIncomeStatus.description: A person who receives or is a member of a family who receives a total family income in the 6 months prior to enrollment of 70 percent of the income standard for a family of that size or that does not exceed the poverty line, or the person is receiving or is a member of a family who is receiving cash assistance payments from Federal, State, or local agencies or food stamps, or the person can be designated as homeless under the McKinney Act.

hasMaritalStatus.description: The marital status of the person as of today.

hasMigrantStatus.description: Persons who are, or whose parents or spouses are, migratory agricultural workers, including migratory dairy workers, or migratory fishers, and who, in the preceding 36 months, in order to obtain, or accompany such parents or spouses, in order to obtain, temporary or seasonal employment in agricultural or fishing work (A) have moved from one LEA to another; (B) in a state that comprises a single LEA, have moved from one administrative area to another within such LEA; or (C) reside in an LEA of more than 15,000 square miles, and migrate a distance of 20 miles or more to a temporary residence to engage in a fishing activity.

hasPerkinsEnglishLearnerStatus.description: A secondary student, an adult, or an out-of-school youth, who has limited ability in speaking, reading, writing, or understanding English language, and (a) whose native language is a language other than English, or (b) who lives in a family or community environment in which a language other than English is the dominant language.

hasProfessionalAssociationMembershipStat.description: An indication of whether the person is a member of a professional organization or association.

hasPublicAssistanceStatus.description: A person who receives financial assistance from Federal, State, or local government agencies, including Temporary Assistance for Needy Families or equivalent.

hasRuralResidencyStatus.description: A person who resides in a place with a population of less than 2,500 that is not near any metropolitan area with a population greater than 50,000, or in a city with adjacent areas of high density.

hasSchoolChoiceAppliedForTransferStatus.description: An indication that a student applied to transfer in the current year (regardless of whether the student transferred), OR previously applied and transferred under the public school choice provisions and continue to attend the transfer school in the current year.

hasSchoolChoiceEligibleForTransferStatus.description: An indication the student is eligible to transfer for the current school year under the public school choice provisions or who applied and transferred in the current school year under the public school choice provisions or previously applied and transferred under the public school choice provisions and continue to attend the transfer school in the current year.

hasSchoolChoiceTransferStatus.description: An indication of whether an eligible student transferred to the school under the provisions for public school choice in accordance with Title I, Part A, Section 1116 of ESEA as amended.

hasSingleParentOrSinglePregnantWomanStat.description: A student who, at some time during the school year, is either a pregnant female student who is unmarried; or a male or female student who is unmarried or legally separated from a spouse and has a minor child or children.

hasStateApprovedTechnicalAssistanceProvi.description: An indication of whether an individual has been approved as a technical assistance provider through a state process.

hasStateApprovedTrainerStatus.description: An indication of whether an individual has been approved as a trainer through a state process.

hasTitleIIIImmigrantStatus.description: An indication that the child is an immigrant according to the Title III of ESEA definition, meaning children who are aged 3 through 21; were not born in any state; and have not been attending one or more schools in any one or more States for more than 3 full academic years.

hasTitleISchoolSupplementalServicesAppli.description: An indication of whether an eligible student applied/requested to receive supplemental educational services under Title I, Part A, Section 1116 of ESEA as amended during the school year.

hasTitleISchoolSupplementalServicesEligi.description: An indication of whether a student is eligible to receive supplemental educational services during the school year in accordance with Title I, Part A, Section 1116 of ESEA as amended.

hasTitleISchoolSupplementalServicesRecei.description: An indication of whether an eligible student received supplemental educational services during the school year in accordance with Title I, Part A, Section 1116 of ESEA as amended.

hasTruantStatus.description: An indication that a student is identified as a truant as defined by state rules.

hasTransportationPublicExpenseEligibilit.description: The type of eligibility for transporting a person at public expense.

hasTransportationStateAidQualificationTy.description: The qualification status for the transportation of a person that entitles an organization to receive state transportation aid.

hasTransportationStatusType.description: The transportation status of the person.

CourseNumber.description: The official reference number portion of a course identifier.  This number normally designates the level of the course as well as the level of the individual expected to enroll in the course.

OriginalCourseIdentifier.description: The course identifier as it was listed when the credit was earned (e.g. before a system conversion) to show consistency between present transcripts and older ones.

OverrideSchoolCourseNumber.description: An indication of the way an academic course was identified at an educational institution.

hasCIPCode.description: A six-digit code in the form xx.xxxx that identifies instructional program specialties within educational institutions.

hasCIPVersion.description: The version of CIP being reported.

hasCourseCreditBasisType.description: The type of enrollment associated with the credit hours for the course.

hasCourseCreditLevelType.description: The level of credit associated with the credit hours earned for the course.

hasNCAAEligibility.description: An indication that the course is approved for determining NCAA eligibility.

hasNCESCollegeCourseMapCode.description: A taxonomy system for coding postsecondary courses in NCES research studies.

hasSCEDCourseSubjectArea.description: The intended major subject area of the education course.

hasAbilityGroupingStatus.description: An indication of whether the school has students who are ability grouped for classroom instruction in mathematics or English/reading/language arts.

hasAdministrativeFundingControl.description: The type of education institution as classified by its funding source.

hasAdmissionConsiderationLevel.description: The level of consideration given a type of admission criteria used at an institution during the selection process.

hasAdmissionConsiderationType.description: The type of admission consideration used at an institution during the selection process.

hasCarnegieBasicClassification.description: The Basic Classification is an update of the traditional classification framework developed by the Carnegie Commission on Higher Education in 1970 to support its research program, and later published in 1973 for use by other researchers.

hasControlOfInstitution.description: A classification of whether a postsecondary institution is operated by publicly elected or appointed officials (public control) or by privately elected or appointed officials and derives its major source of funds from private sources (private control).

hasIncreasedLearningTimeType.description: The types of increased learning time provided.

hasInstitutionallyControlledHousingStatu.description: An indication of whether an institution has any residence hall or housing facility located on- or off-campus that is owned or controlled by an institution and used by the institution in direct support of or in a manner related to, the institution's educational purposes.

hasLevelOfInstitution.description: A classification of whether a postsecondary institution's highest level of offering is a program of 4-years or higher (4 year), 2-but-less-than 4-years (2 year), or less than 2-years.

hasMostPrevalentLevelOfInstitution.description: A classification of a postsecondary institution's most prevalent level.

hasPostsecondaryPriceOfAttendance.description: References the price of attendance data for a postsecondary institution and a given session.

hasPredominantCalendarSystem.description: The method by which an institution structures most of its courses for the academic year.

hasTenureSystem.description: An indicator of whether an institution has personnel positions that lead to consideration for tenure.

hasVirtualIndicator.description: An indication that a childcare, early education, or early learning program, school, institution, program, or course section focuses primarily on instruction in which children and teachers are separated by time and/or location and interact through the use of computers and/or telecommunications technology.

BoardCharges.description: The charges assessed students for an academic year for the maximum meal plan available.

BooksAndSuppliesCosts.description: The average cost for books and supplies for a typical student for an entire academic year (or program). Does not include unusual costs for special groups of students (e.g., engineering or art majors) unless they constitute the majority of students at an institution.

ComprehensiveFee.description: A single fixed amount of money charged by an institution that covers tuition, required fees, room, and board. For some institutions, this amount may also cover books and supplies.

IPEDSCollectionYearDesignator.description: The academic year, generally extending from September to June, in which IPEDS data is collected.  Most Institutional Characteristics, Salaries, Fall Staff, Fall Enrollment, and Employees by Assigned Position data are collected for the current year; Completions, 12-Month Enrollment, Student Financial Aid, and Finance data collections cover the prior year.

OtherStudentExpenses.description: The amount of money (estimated by the financial aid office) needed by a person to cover expenses such as laundry, transportation, and entertainment.

PriceOfAttendance.description: The total amount institutions estimate that undergraduate-level full-time, first-time degree-seeking students will pay to attend before financial aid is considered. This price includes tuition and fees, books and supplies, room and board, and certain other designated expenses such as transportation. These estimates are the average amounts used by the financial aid office to determine a student's financial aid.

RequiredStudentFees.description: Fixed sum charged to persons for items not covered by tuition and required of such a large proportion of all students that the student who does not pay the charge is the exception.

RoomCharges.description: The charges for an academic year for rooming accommodations for a typical student sharing a room with one other student.

SessionDesignator.description: The academic session for which the data are recorded and applicable.

TuitionPublished.description: The published tuition for first time, full-time undergraduate students (lower of in-district or in-state for public institutions).  Tuition may be charged per term, per course, per credit or per program.

hasTuitionUnit.description: The component for which tuition is being charged. It might be a time period (term, quarter, year, etc.) or it might be an entity of education (course, credit hour, etc.).

NormalLengthOfTimeForCompletion.description: The amount of time necessary for a person to complete all requirements for a degree or certificate according to the institution's catalog. This is typically 4 years (8 semesters or trimesters, or 12 quarters, excluding summer terms) for a bachelor's degree in a standard term-based institution; 2 years (4 semesters or trimesters, or 6 quarters, excluding summer terms) for an associate's degree in a standard term-based institution; and the various scheduled times for certificate programs.

ProgramLengthHours.description: The normal length in credit/contact hours of a person's program as published in the institution's catalogue, website, or other official documents.

hasCIPCode.description: A six-digit code in the form xx.xxxx that identifies instructional program specialties within educational institutions.

hasCIPVersion.description: The version of CIP being reported.

hasDQPCategoriesOfLearning.description: The Lumina Foundation's Degree Qualifications Profile offers reference points for what students should know and be able to do upon completion of associate, bachelor's and master's degrees � in any field of study. The DQP Categories of Learning provide a profile of what degrees mean within which specific proficiencies may be defined.

hasNormalLengthOfTimeForCompletionUnits.description: The unit of measurement for length of time for completion.

hasPostsecondaryProgramLevel.description: The level describing the concentration of study for a postsecondary program.

hasPostsecondaryStudentProgram.description: References the classification of a program of a postsecondary student.

hasProgramLengthHoursType.description: The type of hours (credit or contact) by which the normal length of a program of study is measured.

hasCIPCode.description: A six-digit code in the form xx.xxxx that identifies instructional program specialties within educational institutions.

hasCIPVersion.description: The version of CIP being reported.

hasCourseHonorsType.description: An indication that the course is or can be counted as an honors course.

hasCourseInstructionMethod.description: The primary method of instruction used for the course.

hasDevelopmentalEducationType.description: An indicator of the category of developmental education.

hasPostsecondarySectionLocation.description: References information about a location in which a postsecondary course section is delivered.

hasWorkBasedLearningOpportunityType.description: The type of work-based learning opportunity a student participated in.

CourseInstructionSiteName.description: The name of the location at which the course is taught.

hasCourseInstructionSiteType.description: An indication of the type of location at which the course is taught.

hasAcademicRank.description: The academic rank of staff whose primary responsibility is instruction, research, and/or public service. Institutions without standard academic ranks should code staff whose primary responsibility is instruction, research, and/or public service as "No Academic Rank."

hasFacultyStatus.description: Persons identified by the institution as such and typically those whose initial assignments are made for the purpose of conducting instruction, research or public service as a principal activity (or activities). They may hold academic rank titles of professor, associate professor, assistant professor, instructor, lecturer or the equivalent of any of those academic ranks. Faculty may also include the chancellor/president, provost, vice provosts, deans, directors or the equivalent, as well as associate deans, assistant deans and executive officers of academic departments (chairpersons, heads or the equivalent) if their principal activity is instruction combined with research and/or public service. The designation as "faculty" is separate from the activities to which they may be currently assigned. For example, a newly appointed president of an institution may also be appointed as a faculty member. Graduate, instruction, and research assistants are not included in this category.

hasFullTimeStatus.description: An indication of whether an individual is employed for a standard number of hours (as determined by civil or organizational policies) in a week, month, or other period of time.

hasGraduateAssistantIPEDSOccupationCateg.description: The Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) occupational categories used to report graduate assistants.

hasGraduateAssistantStatus.description: Graduate-level students employed on a part-time basis, not limited to, but often employed for the primary purpose of assisting in classroom or laboratory instruction or in the conduct of research. Graduate students having titles such as graduate assistant, teaching assistant, teaching associate, teaching fellow, or research assistant typically hold these positions.

hasIPEDSOccupationalCategory.description: The Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) occupational categories used to report employees.

hasInstructionCreditType.description: A designation of the type(s) of instruction being delivered by staff whose primary responsibility is instruction. Instruction that is for "credit" can be applied toward the requirements for a postsecondary degree, diploma, certificate or other formal award.

hasInstructionalStaffContractLength.description: The contracted teaching period for faculty.

hasInstructionalStaffFacultyTenureStatus.description: An indicator of the type of faculty status a person has if, by institutional definition, a staff member has faculty status.

hasInstructionalStaffStatus.description: Staff whose primary function/occupational activity is primarily instruction or instruction combined with research and/or public service. Does not include medical school staff.

hasMedicalSchoolStaffStatus.description: Staff employed by or employees working in the medical school component of a postsecondary institution or in a free standing medical school. Does not include staff employed by or employees working strictly in a hospital associated with a medical school or those who work in health or allied health schools or departments such as dentistry, veterinary medicine, nursing or dental hygiene.

AcademicAwardDate.description: The year, month and day or year and month on which the academic award was conferred.

AcademicAwardRequirementsURL.description: A URL to a page that describes the requirements for the credential.

AcademicAwardTitle.description: The descriptive title for the academic award.

hasAcademicAwardLevelConferred.description: An indicator of the category of award conferred by a college, university, or other postsecondary education institution as official recognition for the successful completion of a program of study.

hasAcademicAwardPrerequisiteType.description: Prerequisite conditions for earning an academic award.

hasPESCAwardLevelType.description: An indicator of the category of award conferred by a college, university, or other postsecondary education institution as official recognition for the successful completion of a program of study.

APCreditsAwarded.description: The number of credits awarded a student by the postsecondary institution based on successful completion of advanced placement courses and/or advanced placement tests.

AcademicYearDesignator.description: The academic year for which the data apply.

CourseTotal.description: The total number of courses listed on a transcript. Used as a check digit for integrity purposes.

CreditsAttemptedCumulative.description: The cumulative number of credits a person attempts to earn by taking courses during their enrollment in their current education institution as well as those credits transferred from an education institution in which the person had been previously enrolled.

CreditsEarnedCumulative.description: The cumulative number of credits a person earns by completing courses or examinations during their enrollment in the current education institution as well as those credits transferred from an education institution in which the person had been previously enrolled.

DiplomaOrCredentialAwardDate.description: The month and year on which the diploma/credential is awarded to a student in recognition of his/her completion of the curricular requirements.

DualCreditDualEnrollmentCreditsAwarded.description: The number of credits awarded a student by the postsecondary institution based on successful completion of dual credit/dual enrollment courses.

GPACumulative.description: A measure of average performance in all courses taken by a person during his or her school career as determined for record-keeping purposes. This is obtained by dividing the total grade points received by the total number of credits attempted. This usually includes grade points received and credits attempted in his or her current school as well as those transferred from schools in which the person was previously enrolled.

GradePointAverage.description: The value of the total quality points divided by the Credit Hours for Grade Point Average.

NumberOfCreditsAttempted.description: The number of credits that a student can earn for enrolling in and completing a given course.

NumberOfCreditsEarned.description: The number of credits an individual earns by the successful completion of a course.

PostsecondaryStudentEnteringTerm.description: The term and year of the initial enrollment of an individual in credit bearing courses or developmental/remedial courses at an institution after completing high school or a high school equivalency program (e.g., GED, Adult High School Diploma).

hasAcademicTermDesignator.description: The academic term for which the data apply.

hasCreditHoursAppliedOtherProgram.description: Codes identifying the set of credit hours taken in other programs or degrees that were applied to the individual's degree.

hasProfessionalOrTechnicalCredentialConf.description: An indicator of the category of credential conferred by a state occupational licensing entity or industry organization for competency in a specific area measured by a set of pre-established standards.

StandardizedAdmissionTestScore.description: The quantitative score on a standardized admission test reported to a postsecondary institution.

hasStandardizedAdmissionTestType.description: The type of test prepared and administered by an agency that is independent of any postsecondary education institution and is typically used for admissions purposes. Tests provide information about prospective students and their academic qualifications relative to a national sample.

GPACumulative.description: A measure of average performance in all courses taken by a person during his or her school career as determined for record-keeping purposes. This is obtained by dividing the total grade points received by the total number of credits attempted. This usually includes grade points received and credits attempted in his or her current school as well as those transferred from schools in which the person was previously enrolled.

HighSchoolPercentile.description: The High School Rank divided by the Size of High School Graduating Class expressed as a percentage.

HighSchoolStudentClassRank.description: The academic rank of a student in relation to his or her high school graduating class (e.g., 1, 2, 3) based on high school GPA.

TotalNumberInClass.description: The total number of students in the student's high school graduating class.

hasAdmittedStudent.description: Applicant who has been granted an official offer to enroll in a postsecondary institution. Admitted applicants should include wait-listed students who were subsequently offered admission.

hasGPAWeightedIndicator.description: An indication of whether the reported Grade Point Average is weighted or unweighted.

hasGradePointAverageDomain.description: The domain to which the Grade Point Average is referencing.

hasPostsecondaryApplicant.description: An individual who has fulfilled the institution's requirements to be considered for admission (including payment or waiving of the application fee, if any) and who has been notified of one of the following actions: admission, nonadmission, placement on waiting list, or application withdrawn (by applicant or institution). Include early decision, early action, and students who began studies during summer in this cohort.

hasWaitListedStudent.description: A person who meets the admission requirements but will only be offered a place in the class if space becomes available.

CohortGraduationYear.description: The year the cohort is expected to graduate.

CourseNarrativeExplanationGrade.description: The narrative of the grade awarded to an individual in an academic course in those cases where a course does not receive a letter or numeric grade included in the grading scale of the Course Academic Grade Qualifier.

StudentCourseSectionGradeNarrative.description: The narrative of the student performance in a course section as submitted by the instructor.

NumberOfDependents.description: The number of dependents who live with the student and receive more than half their support from them.

hasCampusResidencyType.description: A person's residency arrangement as defined in the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA).

hasChildrenOfFallenHeroesIndicator.description: Pell-eligible students whose parent or guardian was a member of the U.S. armed forces and died as a result of military service performed in Iraq or Afghanistan after the events of 9/11 or a public safety officer and died as a result of active service in the line of duty. At the time of the parent's or guardian's death, the student must be less than 24 years of age or enrolled in college or career school at least part-time.

hasCohortExclusion.description: Those persons who may be removed (deleted) from a cohort (or subcohort). For the Graduation Rates and Fall Enrollment retention rate reporting, persons may be removed from a cohort if they left the institution for one of the following reasons: death or total and permanent disability; service in the armed forces (including those called to active duty); service with a foreign aid service of the federal government, such as the Peace Corps; or service on official church missions.

hasDependencyStatus.description: A person's classification as dependent or independent with regards to eligibility for Title IV Federal Student aid.

hasEmancipatedMinor.description: A minor student under the age of 18 who has been granted by legal action to have the power and capacity of an adult.

hasFirstGenerationCollegeStudent.description: The term First Generation College Student means an individual both of whose parents did not complete a baccalaureate degree or in the case of any individual who regularly resided with and received support from only one parent, an individual whose only such parent did not complete a baccalaureate degree.

hasMaternalGuardianEducation.description: The highest level of education attained by a person's mother or maternal guardian

hasNumberOfDependentsType.description: The student's relationship to the dependents who live with the student or receive more than half of the student's support

hasPaternalGuardianEducation.description: The highest level of education attained by a person's father or paternal guardian

hasTuitionResidencyType.description: A person's residency status for tuition purposes.

hasEmployedAfterExit.description: An individual who is a paid employee or works in his or her own business, profession, or farm, as reported through the State Unemployment Insurance Wage Report, FEDES, or WRIS, after exiting secondary, postsecondary, or adult education or workforce programs.

hasEmployedWhileEnrolled.description: An individual who is a paid employee or works in his or her own business, profession, or farm, as reported through the State Unemployment Insurance Wage Report, FEDES, or WRIS, and at the same time is enrolled in secondary, postsecondary, or adult education or workforce programs.

hasEmploymentNAICSCode.description: The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code associated with an individual's employment.

hasEmploymentStatusWhileEnrolled.description: An indication of the individual's employment status while enrolled.

DoctoralCandidacyDate.description: The date on which the individual was admitted to doctoral candidate status.

DoctoralExamTakenDate.description: The date on which the individual took an exam for advancement in, continuation or completion of a doctoral program.

EntryDateIntoPostsecondary.description: The year, month and day on which a person entered and began to receive instructional services at a postsecondary institution for the first time after completing high school (or its equivalent).

InitialEnrollmentTerm.description: The first registration term of a person enrolling in credit-granting courses at a postsecondary institution after completing high school (or its equivalent).

InstructionalActivityHoursAttempted.description: The number of credit hours and/or contact hours attempted by a person during a term.

InstructionalActivityHoursCompleted.description: The number of credit hours and/or contact hours successfully completed by a person during a term.

OralDefenseDate.description: The date on which the individual gave an oral defense.

ThesisOrDissertationTitle.description: The title of the thesis or dissertation.

hasAdultEducationStudentAcademicRecord.description: References information in a student's academic record specific to adult education program participation.

hasAdultEducationStudentEmployment.description: References information about student employment specific to the adult education context.

hasDegreeOrCertificateSeekingStudent.description: Person is enrolled in courses for credit and recognized by the institution as seeking a degree, certificate, or other formal award. High school students also enrolled in postsecondary courses for credit are not considered degree/certificate-seeking.

hasDevelopmentalEducationReferralStatus.description: The status of a student's referral to or placement into developmental education.

hasDevelopmentalEducationType.description: An indicator of the category of developmental education.

hasDisplacedStudentStatus.description: A student who was enrolled, or eligible for enrollment, but has enrolled in another place because of a crisis.

hasDistanceEducationCourseEnrollment.description: An individual's enrollment in a course or courses in which the instructional content is delivered exclusively via distance education. Distance education is education that uses one or more technologies to deliver instruction to students who are separated from the instructor and to support regular and substantive interaction between the students and the instructor synchronously or asynchronously. Technologies used for instruction may include: Internet; one-way and two-way transmissions through open broadcasts, closed circuit, cable, microwave, broadband lines, fiber optics, satellite or wireless communication devices; audio conferencing; and video cassette, DVDs, and CD-ROMs, if the cassette, DVDs, and CD-ROMs are used in a course in conjunction with the technologies listed above.

hasDistanceEducationProgramEnrollmentInd.description: An individual's enrollment in a program for which all the required coursework for program completion is able to be completed via distance education courses. Distance education is education that uses one or more technologies to deliver instruction to individuals who are separated from the instructor and to support regular and substantive interaction between the individuals and the instructor synchronously or asynchronously.

hasDoctoralCandidacyAdmitIndicator.description: The individual's status in being admitted as a doctoral candidate.

hasDoctoralExamsRequiredType.description: A qualifier identifying the types of exams required of doctoral level individuals.

hasEnrollmentInPostsecondaryAwardType.description: An indicator of the award level in which the person is currently enrolled.

hasFirstTimePostsecondaryStudent.description: A person who has no prior postsecondary experience attending any institution for the first time at the undergraduate level since completing high school (or its equivalent). This includes persons enrolled in academic or occupational programs. It also includes persons enrolled in the fall term who attended college for the first time in the prior summer term, and persons who entered with advanced standing (college credits earned before graduation from high school).

hasFraternityParticipationStatus.description: Student is in membership of a chiefly social organization of men students at a college or university, usually designated by Greek letters.

hasGraduateOrDoctoralExamResultsStatus.description: The individual's status in completing exams required for graduate or doctoral degree programs.

hasInstructionalActivityHoursType.description: The unit of measure of student instructional activity.

hasOralDefenseCompletedIndicator.description: An indication of the individual's completion of an oral defense. The requirement to conduct an oral defense by doctoral individuals may vary across institutions, programs, or fields of study.

hasPostsecondaryEnrollmentStatus.description: An indication of the student's enrollment status for a particular term as defined by the institution

hasPostsecondaryEnrollmentType.description: An indicator of the enrollment type associated with the enrollment award level of a person at the beginning of a term.

hasPostsecondaryEnteringStudentIndicator.description: The initial enrollment of an individual in credit bearing courses or developmental/remedial courses at an institution after completing high school or a high school equivalency program (e.g. GED, Adult High School Diploma).

hasPostsecondaryExitOrWithdrawalType.description: The circumstances under which the student exited from enrollment in a postsecondary institution.

hasPostsecondaryStudentAcademicAward.description: References an award conferred by a college, university, or other postsecondary education institution as official recognition for the successful completion of a program of study.

hasPostsecondaryStudentAcademicRecord.description: References the summary level academic record for a postsecondary student including graduation information.

hasPostsecondaryStudentAdmissionTest.description: References a student's performance on a test prepared and administered by an agency that is independent of any postsecondary education institution and is typically used for admissions purposes.

hasPostsecondaryStudentApplication.description: References information on an individual who submits an application for admission to a postsecondary institution.

hasPostsecondaryStudentCohort.description: References information about a cohort of postsecndary students.

hasPostsecondaryStudentDemographic.description: References additional attributes for a postsecondary student (beyond those demographic attributes stored in PersonDemographic)

hasPostsecondaryStudentEmployment.description: References employment information for a postsecondary student.

hasPostsecondaryStudentEnrollment.description: References attributes of a person enrolled at a postsecondary institution.

hasPostsecondaryStudentFinancialAid.description: References information on a person who applies for financial aid to participate in postsecondary education.

hasPostsecondaryStudentHousingOnCampus.description: The student resides in a residence hall or housing facility owned or controlled by an institution within the same reasonably contiguous geographic area and used by the institution in direct support of or in a manner related to, the institution's educational purposes.

hasPostsecondaryStudentProgram.description: References the classification of a program of a postsecondary student.

hasSororityParticipationStatus.description: Student is in membership in a chiefly social organization of women students at a college or university, usually designated by Greek letters.

hasStudentLevel.description: Classification of a person enrolling in credit-granting courses at a postsecondary institution since completing high school (or its equivalent) as either an undergraduate or graduate student.

hasTransferReady.description: A person who has successfully completed a transfer-preparatory program as defined by the state or by the institution if no official state definition exists.

FinancialAidIncomeLevel.description: The income level of an individual that is used by an institution's financial aid office to determine an individual's Expected Family Contribution (EFC).  For dependent students this will include the parents' adjusted gross income and the student's adjusted gross income.  For independent students this will include the student's adjusted gross income.

FinancialNeed.description: The amount of financial need as determined by an institution using the federal methodology and/or your institution's own standards.

hasRubricCriterion.description: References a single criterion by which one aspect of an entity's competence may be evaluated.

RubricCriterionCategory.description: A textual label for category by which Rubric Criterion may be grouped.

RubricCriterionDescription.description: Text describing a criterion that must be met to demonstrate quality for a product, process, or performance task.

RubricCriterionPosition.description: A numeric value representing this criterion's position in the criteria list for this rubric.

RubricCriterionTitle.description: The title of the rubric criterion.

RubricCriterionWeight.description: A numeric weight assigned to this Rubric Criterion, used for scored rubrics.

hasRubricCriterionLevel.description: References a degree or level of competence.

RubricCriterionLevelDescription.description: Text describing  one or more benchmarks that must be met to achieve a degree of achievement on a product, process, or performance task.

RubricCriterionLevelFeedback.description: Pre-defined feedback text to be relayed to the person or organization being evaluated.  This may include guidance and suggestions for improvement or development.

RubricCriterionLevelPosition.description: A numeric value representing the level's position in the list of levels defined for the Rubric Criterion.

RubricCriterionLevelQualityLabel.description: A qualitative description of this degree of achievement used for column headers or row labels in tabular rubrics.

RubricCriterionLevelScore.description: The points awarded for achieving this level.

hasAssessmentItemRubricCriterionResult.description: References information about an assessment result or score derived using a rubic criterion.

hasAssessmentResultRubricCriterionResult.description: References information that links an assessment result record to a result defined within a RubricCriterion.

OperationalStatusEffectiveDate.description: The effective date for a change in operational status.

hasSchoolOperationalStatus.description: The current status of the school operations, exclusive of scheduled breaks, holidays, or other temporary interruptions.

DurationLengthinMinutes.description: The number of minutes in an instance.

FrequencyInstancesperCycle.description: The number of recurrences within a cycle.

FrequencyLength.description: The number of units within a repeating cycle. Used with Frequency and Frequency Units elements to describe the occurrence of repeating events such as student services delivered 3 times a week for 16 weeks.

hasFrequencyUnit.description: The unit of time by which a cycle is defined.

ServiceEntryDate.description: The year, month and day on which a person begins to receive early intervention, special education or other services.

ServiceExitDate.description: The year, month and day on which a person stops receiving early intervention or special education services.

hasServicePlan.description: References a plan to provide services to a person, group, or a person's family, such as services delivered under Individualized Education Programs or Individualized Family Services Plans.

hasServiceStaff.description: References relationship to the person-role that provided the service.

hasServicesReceived.description: References information about services received such as services received by a student. May link individual services received to a service plan.

DeclinedServicesDate.description: The date recommended services were declined.

ReasonForDeclinedServices.description: The reason given for declining the recommended services.

ServiceSettingDescription.description: Description of the setting in which the services are delivered.

hasInclusiveSettingIndicator.description: Indicates that services are provided to the child in a place where children of all abilities learn together.

hasServiceExtendsOutsideSchoolYear.description: Determination if this service continues outside school year.

hasServiceFrequency.description: References information about the schedule and frequency by which services are planned to be deliverd.

hasEarlyChildhoodServicesReceived.description: The types of service that adapts the curriculum, materials, or instruction for students identified as needing additional resources.

hasServiceProvider.description: References information about an organization responsible for administering services to an individual or organization participating in a program or receiving services.

hasStudentSupportServiceType.description: Type of related or ancillary services offered or provided to a person or a group of persons within the formal educational system or by an outside agency which provides non-instructional services to support the general welfare of students. This includes physical and emotional health, the ability to select an appropriate course of study, admission to appropriate educational programs, and the ability to adjust to and remain in school through the completion of programs. In serving a student with an identified disability, related services include developmental, corrective, or supportive services required to ensure that the person benefits from special education.

hasServiceStaff.description: References relationship to the person-role that provided the service.

hasSpecialEducationSupportServicesCatego.description: Titles of personnel employed and contracted to provide special education and related services for children with disabilities.

SpecialEducationFTE.description: Calculated ratio of time the student is in a special education setting. Values range from 0.00 to 1.00. If the student is in a special education setting 25% of the time, the value is .25; if 100% of the time, the value is 1.00.

hasServicePlan.description: References a plan to provide services to a person, group, or a person's family, such as services delivered under Individualized Education Programs or Individualized Family Services Plans.

hasServiceProvided.description: References services available from an organization or person that may be linked ServicePlan and ServicesRecieved information.

StaffCompensationAnnualSupplement.description: The annual sum of payments given to staff in addition to their regular wages.

StaffCompensationAnnualSupplementDescrip.description: A description of the annual supplement awarded to a staff member.

StaffCompensationBaseSalary.description: The salary or wage a person is paid before deductions (excluding differentials) but including annuities.

StaffCompensationHealthBenefits.description: Contributions made by the school district, municipal, state, federal and other government agencies for the teacher's or early learning provider's health insurance, prorated to the specific school or local provider agency indicated on the record, not including contributions made by the teacher or early learning provider.

StaffCompensationLongevity.description: Compensation paid to a staff member based on their years of service.

StaffCompensationOtherBenefits.description: All other benefits paid by the school district, municipal, state, federal, and other government agencies for the teacher or early learning provider, prorated to the specific school or local provider agency indicated on the record, not including retirement and health insurance benefits or contributions made by the teacher or early learning provider.

StaffCompensationRetirementBenefits.description: Contributions made by the school district, municipal, state, federal and other government agencies for the teacher's or early learning provider's health insurance, prorated to the specific school or local provider agency indicated on the record, not including contributions made by the teacher or early learning provider.

StaffCompensationTotalBenefits.description: Sum of retirement, health, and all other benefits, or total benefits paid by the school district, municipal, state, federal and other government agencies for the teacher's or early learning provider's health insurance, prorated to the specific school or local provider agency indicated on the record, not including contributions made by the teacher or early learning provider.

StaffCompensationTotalSalary.description: Total annualized salary of staff at the specific school/program indicated on the record in the school/program year  specified on the record.

hasStaffCompensationFundingSource.description: References the relationship between the staff compensation and the financial account used for the compensation.

hasStaffCompensationSourceType.description: The source for the staff compensation a person receives.

FundingSourceAmount.description: The amount of financial support contributed by a specific funding or revenue stream.

FundingSourcePercentage.description: The proportion or percentage of financial support or resources contributed by a specific funding or revenue stream in relation to the total funding.

hasFinancialAccount.description: References summary of financial transactions that provides information to external financial statement users.

CPRCertificationExpirationDate.description: The date an individual's cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) training certification expires.

DiplomaOrCredentialAwardDate.description: The month and year on which the diploma/credential is awarded to a student in recognition of his/her completion of the curricular requirements.

FirstAidCertificationExpirationDate.description: The date an individual's first aid training certification expires.

hasAdultEducationCertificationType.description: An indication of the category of the adult education certification a person holds.

hasCTEInstructorIndustryCertification.description: An indication of whether a Career and Technical Education (CTE) instructor holds a current industry-recognized credential related to their teaching field.

hasChildDevelopmentAssociateType.description: Type of Child Development Associate credential as defined by options.

hasParaprofessionalQualificationStatus.description: An indication of whether paraprofessionals are classified as qualified for their assignment according to state definition.

hasProgramSponsorType.description: A type of organization providing funds for a particular educational or service program or activity or for an individual's participation in the program or activity.

hasTeachingCredentialBasis.description: An indication of the pre-determined criteria for granting the teaching credential that a person holds.

hasTeachingCredentialType.description: An indication of the category of a legal document giving authorization to perform teaching assignment services.

hasTechnologySkillsStandardsMet.description: An indication that the person has achieved acceptable performance on a standards-based profile of technology user skills as defined by the state.

StaffEducationEntryDate.description: The year, month and day that a staff member began participating in an educational experience (course, educational program, or formal education activity).

StaffEducationWithdrawalDate.description: The year, month and day that an individual ceased participating in an educational experience without completing the course, educational program, or staff development activity.

StaffEvaluationOutcome.description: The result of an assessment of a person's performance.

StaffEvaluationScoreOrRating.description: The actual quantitative or qualitative assessment of a person's overall performance.

StaffEvaluationSystem.description: The instrument and/or set of procedures with which a person's performance is assessed.

hasFacultyAndAdministrationPerformanceLe.description: The levels used in district evaluation systems for assigning teacher or principal performance ratings.

hasStaffEvaluationPart.description: References information about the score and sections of a staff evaluation assessment.

hasStaffEvaluationScale.description: The quantitative or qualitative range of possible scores/rating for a person's overall performance (e.g., 0 - 10; Poor, Fair, Average, Good, Excellent).

StaffEvaluationPartName.description: The name of the component part that is being evaluated and scored.

StaffEvaluationPartScale.description: The quantitative or qualitative range of possible scores/rating for a person's performance on a component part (e.g., 0 - 10; Poor, Fair, Average, Good, Excellent).

StaffEvaluationPartScoreOrRating.description: The actual quantitative or qualitative assessment of a person's performance on a component part that is being evaluated.

YearsOfPriorProfessionalExperience.description: The total number of years that an individual has previously held a similar professional position in one or more education institutions prior to the current school year.

YearsOfPriorTeachingExperience.description: The total number of years prior to this job that a person has previously held a teaching position in one or more education institutions.

YearsOfTotalExperience.description: The total number of years that a person has held this position or a similar position in one or more organizations.

YearsofPriorAETeachingExperience.description: The total number of years that a person has previously held a teaching position in one or more adult education programs.

NumberOfCreditsEarned.description: The number of credits an individual earns by the successful completion of a course.

ProfessionalDevelopmentActivityIdentifie.description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to the Professional Development Activity as assigned by the organization offering the training.

ProfessionalDevelopmentActivityTitle.description: The title of an activity designed for the purpose of developing someone professionally.

StaffProfessionalDevelopmentActivityComp.description: The year, month and day on which an individual completed a course, an education program or a staff development activity.

StaffProfessionalDevelopmentActivityStar.description: The year, month and day on which an individual begins a course, an education program or a staff development activity.

hasCoreKnowledgeArea.description: References the core knowledge areas addressed by a professional development activity most commonly used in the early learning domain.

hasCourseCreditUnits.description: The type of credit (unit, semester, or quarter) associated with the credit hours earned for the course.

hasCreditsEarned.description: A quantifiable unit of recognition awarded for the successful completion of a learning activity measured according to a predefined standard.

hasProfessionalDevelopmentActivity.description: References an activity designed for the purpose of developing someone professionally.

hasProfessionalDevelopmentFinancialSuppo.description: The type of financial assistance received in support of non-credit professional development activities.

hasProfessionalDevelopmentScholarshipSta.description: An indication of whether a scholarship was received for the person to participate in the professional development.

hasProfessionalDevelopmentSession.description: References information about part or all of a Professional Development Activity scheduled for delivery within a single day.

hasTechnicalAssistanceApprovedIndicator.description: Indicates whether or not the technical assistance was approved.

hasTechnicalAssistanceDeliveryType.description: The method of delivery of technical assistance received/provided

hasTechnicalAssistanceType.description: The type of technical assistance provided.

hasStateANSICode.description: The American National Standards Institute (ANSI) two-digit code for the state.

hasStateEducationAgencyFederalFunds.description: References information on the federal funds received by the SEA.

DateStateReceivedTitleIIIAllocation.description: Annual date the State receives the Title III allocation from U.S. Department of Education (ED).

DateTitleIIIFundsAvailableToSubgrantees.description: Annual date that Title III funds are available to approved subgrantees.

NumberOfDaysForTitleIIISubgrants.description: Average number of days for States receiving Title III funds to make subgrants to subgrantees beginning from July 1 of each year, except under conditions where funds are being withheld.

SchoolImprovementReservedFundsPercentage.description: An indication of the percentage of the Title I, Part A allocation that the SEA reserved in accordance with Section 1003(a) of ESEA and �200.100(a) of ED's regulations governing the reservation of funds for school improvement under Section 1003(a) of ESEA.

hasStateTransferabilityOfFunds.description: Did the State transfer funds under the State Transferability authority of Section 6123(a)

CourseAddDate.description: The date an individual was added to an academic course at a school.

CourseDropDate.description: The date on which the individual drops or withdraws from the course.

CourseSectionEnrollmentStatusEndDate.description: The date on which the enrollment status ended related to a student enrolled in an instance of a course.

CourseSectionEnrollmentStatusStartDate.description: The date on which the enrollment status began related to a student enrolled in an instance of a course.

CourseSectionExitWithdrawalDate.description: The year, month and day of the first day after the date of a person's last enrollment in a course section.

GradeValueQualifier.description: The scale of equivalents, if applicable, for grades awarded as indicators of performance in schoolwork. For example, numerical equivalents for letter grades used in determining a student's Grade Point Average (A=4, B=3, C=2, D=1 in a four-point system) or letter equivalents for percentage grades (90-100%=A, 80-90%=B, etc.)

NumberOfCreditsAttempted.description: The number of credits that a student can earn for enrolling in and completing a given course.

NumberOfCreditsEarned.description: The number of credits an individual earns by the successful completion of a course.

NumberOfDaysInAttendance.description: The number of days a person is present when school is in session during a given reporting period.

StudentCourseSectionGradeEarned.description: A final indicator of student performance in a course section as submitted by the instructor.

hasAdditionalCreditType.description: The type of credits or units of value available for the completion of a course in addition to Carnegie Units.

hasCourseRepeatCode.description: Indicates that an academic course has been repeated by a student and how that repeat is to be computed in the student's academic grade average.

hasCourseSectionEnrollmentStatusType.description: The status related to a student enrollment in an instance of a course.

hasCourseSectionEntryType.description: The process by which a student enters a school (Course Section) during a given academic session.

hasCourseSectionExitType.description: The circumstances under which the student exited from membership in a course section.

hasCreditUnitType.description: The type of credits or units of value awarded for the completion of a course.

hasExitOrWithdrawalStatus.description: An indication as to whether an instance of student exit/withdrawal is considered to be of a permanent or temporary nature.

hasGradeLevelWhenCourseTaken.description: Student's grade level at time of course.

hasK12StudentCourseSectionMark.description: References the detail information for the reason and action taken for a discipline event of a K12 student.

hasPreAndPostTestIndicator.description: An indication of whether students took both a pre-test and a post-test to measure academic improvement.

hasProgressLevel.description: The amount of progress shown in academic subjects.

hasTuitionFunded.description: Indicates that tuition for person's participation in a program, service, or course is funded or partially funded by an external grant program.

hasAssessmentResult.description: References an entity that includes information about a person's results from an assessment which may be for the entire assessment or one aspect of evaluation. The scoring method is defined by the related Assessment Subtest. The entity includes the score value and information about the score, such as a diagnostic statement.

hasTeacherEducationCredentialExamScoreTy.description: An indication of the type of credential exam associated with a given exam score.

hasTeacherEducationCredentialExamType.description: The type of examination used to assess teacher candidate's knowledge and skills.

hasTeacherEducationTestCompany.description: The name of the company that provides the examination used in the teacher education program.

hasK12StudentCourseSection.description: References a specific type of Membership that represents a student’s enrollment in a specific course section, characterized by properties related to their participation and performance over a defined period of time.

TelephoneNumber.description: The telephone number including the area code, and extension, if applicable.

hasDoNotPublishIndicator.description: An indication that the record should not be published.

hasInstitutionTelephoneNumberType.description: The type of communication number listed for an organization.

hasPersonPersonalInformationVerification.description: References information related to the type of personal information used (e.g., Birth Certificate) and for what purpose.

hasPrimaryTelephoneNumberIndicator.description: An indication that the telephone number should be used as the principal number for a person or organization.

hasTelephoneNumberListedStatus.description: An indication of whether a telephone number is listed under a directory assistance service.

hasTelephoneNumberType.description: The type of communication number listed for a person.

PersonEmployedInMultipleJobsCount.description: The number of jobs held by a person during the reference period.

hasEmployedAfterExit.description: An individual who is a paid employee or works in his or her own business, profession, or farm, as reported through the State Unemployment Insurance Wage Report, FEDES, or WRIS, after exiting secondary, postsecondary, or adult education or workforce programs.

hasEmployedWhileEnrolled.description: An individual who is a paid employee or works in his or her own business, profession, or farm, as reported through the State Unemployment Insurance Wage Report, FEDES, or WRIS, and at the same time is enrolled in secondary, postsecondary, or adult education or workforce programs.

hasMilitaryEnlistmentAfterExit.description: An individual who is a member of the uniformed armed forces of the United States as reported through FEDES after exiting secondary, postsecondary, or adult education or workforce programs.

CohortMedianEarnings.description: The midpoint between the lowest and highest quarterly wage, in U.S. dollars, for the total number of persons included in the cohort for the period of time between the Employment Record Reference Period Start Date and Employment Record Reference Period End Date.

DiplomaOrCredentialAwardDate.description: The month and year on which the diploma/credential is awarded to a student in recognition of his/her completion of the curricular requirements.

WorkforceProgramParticipationEndDate.description: The year, month, and day of the last day of the reference period during which data are matched between education and workforce data sources.

WorkforceProgramParticipationStartDate.description: The year, month, and day of the first day of the reference period during which data are matched between education and workforce data sources.

hasCIPCode.description: A six-digit code in the form xx.xxxx that identifies instructional program specialties within educational institutions.

hasCIPVersion.description: The version of CIP being reported.

hasProfessionalOrTechnicalCredentialConf.description: An indicator of the category of credential conferred by a state occupational licensing entity or industry organization for competency in a specific area measured by a set of pre-established standards.

hasWorkforceProgramType.description: The type of workforce and employment development program that an individual is participating in.
